big_case.notes: High-salience Solicitor General emergency stay application over a classwide preliminary injunction and universal 5 U.S.C. § 705 stay blocking the Bureau of Prisons' 2026 Program Statement on gender-dysphoria medical care (implementing Executive Order 14168) for roughly 2,000 transgender federal inmates. The Court's 7-2 denial (only Justices Thomas and Alito noting they would grant) is a notable shadow-docket loss for the SG on an Executive Order policy and underscores the weight of preserving a 30-year medical treatment status quo during an expedited D.C. Circuit appeal, though the order itself is interlocutory and non-precedential.
